# Anthropic Hand-Drawn Assets

Internal archive of Anthropic hand-drawn-style assets collected on 2026-04-05.

## Scope
- `skilljar/`: 16 course promo images from `anthropic.skilljar.com`.
- `help/`: 15 Help Center collection icons from `support.claude.com`.
- `news/`: 57 newsroom illustration SVGs mapped to article titles and URLs.
- `claude-product/`: 1 confirmed external product illustration plus 8 inline background SVG variants from `claude.com/product/overview`.

## Files
- `manifest.json`: master index with counts, source URLs, local paths, and notes.
- `skilljar/`: course-level asset files using course slugs.
- `help/`: collection-level icon files using `collection__icon` naming.
- `news/`: article-level SVG files using article slugs.
- `claude-product/backgrounds/`: extracted inline SVG background variants.

## Notes
- This collection is intended for internal reference and reuse planning.
- Original rights remain with Anthropic and/or the original source owners.
- Review redistribution and licensing terms before publishing these files outside a private team context.
- `claude.ai` itself was not directly collectible at collection time because the public site returned a Cloudflare `403` challenge.
- `docs.anthropic.com` did not expose matching hand-drawn public assets on the landing page at collection time.
